items.description: Professional overhead flat-lay photo on white shiplap boards. The 'Nephite Christmas' hardcover (blue cover; boy in red headband holding a torch in front of a stone archway; 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler, Illustrated by Kelley Hicken') overlaps the coloring book ('Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure! Coloring and Activity [Book]'). Props: kraft gift box with ribbon, flocked pine branch, wooden bead garland, wooden snowflake, gold bells, gold star lantern, gold mesh ribbon. No overlay text.
items.new_site_use: Hero or 'Complete Set' bundle bar background, and a strong OG/social image. This is the clean source photo behind the promos 2-scaled.jpg and 7-1.webp. It has room on the right for overlaid copy.

items.description: Angled 3D render of the 'Easter Journey' hardcover on a clean transparent background (about 44% of the pixels are opaque). The front cover shows 'Easter Journey', 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler' and 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'. The spine reads 'EASTER JOURNEY' and 'WHEELER'.
items.new_site_use: Hero (both-books composite), Easter product card and product gallery, bundle bar. Its transparency makes compositing with the Nephite Christmas cutouts easy.

items.description: Flat front cover art of 'Easter Journey' (script 'Easter' above serif 'JOURNEY'), 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler' and 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'. A smiling gray-bearded man in red and green robes gestures toward the viewer. A laughing woman and man wave palm fronds, and Jesus rides a donkey on a Jerusalem street in the background (Triumphal Entry). The cover shows no 'Promised Messiah' subtitle.
items.new_site_use: Primary Easter product card and gallery image, and a hero element. The art can be cropped for Easter section backgrounds.

items.description: Background-removed cutout of the 'Nephite Christmas' hardcover overlapping the 'Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure! Coloring and Activity Book'. It is the same photo as 7.png with the backdrop removed. The edges looked clean on a magenta test.
items.new_site_use: Hero or bundle-bar compositing next to closed-book.png (Easter). Also works as a Nephite Christmas product card image on a brand-color background.

items.description: Background-removed cutout of the Nephite Christmas hardcover, the coloring book, and a round white ceramic ornament reading 'Nephite Christmas' with a gold star, hung on gold ribbon. It is the same photo as Bundle-with-ornament.png with the backdrop removed.
items.new_site_use: Image for a 'deluxe / gift set' bundle (book, coloring book and ornament) in the bundle bar or as an upsell.

items.description: Studio photo of the 'Nephite Christmas' hardcover overlapping the coloring book ('Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure! Coloring and Activity...') on a plain light gray seamless backdrop. Square crop.
items.new_site_use: Product gallery image or bundle card (book plus coloring book). Adobe-Express-file-1 is the transparent version.

items.description: Studio photo on a light gray backdrop of the Nephite Christmas hardcover, the coloring book, and a white ceramic 'Nephite Christmas' ornament with a gold star on gold ribbon. Despite its name, the 2048x2046 file 'Bundle-with-ornament_transparent.webp' still has its background. Its alpha channel is broken: holes cut into the white title lettering and highlights (verified over magenta). Do not use it as a transparent asset.
items.new_site_use: Gallery image for the gift set or ornament bundle. For a larger size, the 2048 _transparent.webp could be flattened onto a matching light gray, but it may be upscaled. Adobe-Express-file-2 is the working cutout.

items.description: Warm lifestyle photo of an older woman with short dark hair and glasses reading the 'Nephite Christmas' hardcover to two young blonde girls in gray sweaters, seated in a leather chair against a white wall. The cover text is readable ('Nephite Christmas', 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler', 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'). There is slight grain and softness from processing. Whether the woman is the author is not confirmed.
items.new_site_use: Emotional lifestyle band ('a new family Christmas tradition'), beside reviews, or as a secondary hero or ad-landing image. Could be the About photo if the client confirms the woman is Tiffany.

items.description: Candid photo of a mother with long brown hair in a cream sweater reading with a young boy in a teal Fair Isle holiday sweater. The boy points at an open picture book at the lower right, and a light couch is behind them. The book is only partly visible (blue edge, illustrated page). That it is Nephite Christmas is an inference.
items.new_site_use: Small lifestyle tile, a 'why families love it' section, or a review-card background. The resolution is too low for a full-width hero.

items.description: Overhead shot of a child in a red long-sleeve shirt coloring a Nephite Christmas coloring book page (bordered line art of a boy lying down) with a red crayon on a wooden table. The coloring book cover ('Coloring and Activit[y]...', boy in red headband) lies upside down beside it.
items.new_site_use: Lifestyle shot in the coloring book product gallery, or proof for the 'includes activity book' bundle messaging. The resolution is low.

items.description: Flat front cover of the physical coloring book, centered on a square canvas. The .png has transparent side margins; the .jpg and .webp files have white ones. Cover text: 'Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure!' and 'Coloring and Activity Book'. The cartoon boy (red headband, teal tank top) waves in front of a Mesoamerican stepped temple and palm trees under a starry blue sky. There is no badge. coloring-book-cover-thumbnail.webp and thumbnail0.webp are pixel-identical.
items.new_site_use: Product card or gallery image for the printed coloring book, and an add-on or upsell thumbnail in the cart or bundle bar.

items.description: The same coloring book cover art ('Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure!' / 'Coloring and Activity Book') on a square canvas, with a white diagonal corner badge at the bottom right reading 'PDF Download'. The thumbnail .png and .webp have transparent sides. for-website-download.webp (1080) and Coloring-Book-Download-Cover-.webp and -1-1.webp (1020x1020) have light gray or white sides.
items.new_site_use: Product image for a digital PDF download of the coloring book, if it stays a product (for example a low-price add-on or an email lead magnet).

items.description: Full-bleed portrait version of the coloring book front cover ('Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure!' / 'Coloring and Activity Book'): the waving boy in front of a temple and palms, with no badge. CB1 (789x1018) is the same art with a slightly different crop and is the first of the CB1-CB6 page set. Both have alpha channels but are effectively opaque.
items.new_site_use: First slide of the coloring book peek-inside carousel (followed by CB2-CB6), or a portrait product thumbnail.

items.description: Full-bleed portrait coloring book cover (same art as CB1) with a white diagonal 'PDF Download' badge in the bottom-right corner.
items.new_site_use: Portrait thumbnail for the PDF download variant. Otherwise redundant with the square download group.

items.description: Black-and-white interior title page of the coloring book: 'Nephite Christmas' in hand lettering, a line-art dove perched on a stack of engraved metal plates (likely the gold plates), and 'Coloring and Activity Book'. It has a busy patterned border of small line icons (doves, sheep, figures, suns, leaves).
items.new_site_use: Coloring book peek-inside gallery.

items.description: Activity page 'Decode Nephi's Message': a symbol cipher key grid (A-X) on a scroll with an encoded message below, a Mesoamerican stepped temple, palm trees, two suns and a crescent moon, inside a geometric tribal-pattern border. Page number 1, with 'Solution on pg 26'.
items.new_site_use: Coloring book peek-inside gallery. It shows the book's activity value beyond coloring.

items.description: Activity page 'Connect the Dots': a numbered dot-to-dot (about 1-45) forming a bearded man in a robe, with his face and hair partly drawn, inside a border of stars, palm trees, suns and spiral motifs. Page 8.
items.new_site_use: Coloring book peek-inside gallery.

items.description: Coloring page: the headband boy holds a picture or paper while a girl with pigtails points at it. A sun, bushes and a crenellated wall or tower with a banner are behind them, inside a geometric pattern border. Page 14.
items.new_site_use: Coloring book peek-inside gallery.

items.description: Coloring page: a woman shading her eyes and a headband boy pointing up at bright stars and a crescent moon in the night sky (likely the sign of Christ's birth), inside a swirl and diamond pattern border. Page 22.
items.new_site_use: Coloring book peek-inside gallery. Also works as a quiet decorative element for the Nephite Christmas story section.

items.description: Animated GIF (41 frames at 0.10 s each, about 4.1 s loop) of the Nephite Christmas cartoon boy (red headband, teal tank top) on a transparent background. He waves, then strikes a thoughtful pose (fist to chin, eyes closed), then waves again. He appears to hold a pencil at the bottom edge. There is a faint white fringe on one ear edge. File size is 1.6 MB.
items.new_site_use: Playful accent near the CTA or story section, empty-cart state, or 404 page. Convert to animated WebP or MP4/WebM (or a sprite) to cut the 1.6 MB weight, and do not put it above the fold on mobile.

items.description: AI-generated (per filename) soft watercolor background: a lavender and periwinkle misty sky with white star dots, a hazy silhouette of a Mesoamerican stepped temple and palm trees at lower left, fading to off-white textured watercolor paper on the right. No text.
items.new_site_use: Background texture for the hero or Nephite Christmas section. The empty right side leaves room for headline and CTA. It suits a light, dreamy brand palette.

items.description: Print-on-demand (Printify-style) mockup of a landscape canvas print seen nearly head-on on white. The artwork shows a woman in a blue head covering (likely Mary Magdalene) looking up in awe at the open garden tomb with its rolled stone and pink flowers, while a glowing white-robed figure (the resurrected Christ) stands at the right edge. The style matches the Easter Journey illustrations.
items.new_site_use: Skip for launch unless canvas wall art is sold. The artwork could be cropped as an Easter story image, but the canvas texture is visible, so the original art file would be better.

items.description: Angled 3/4 view of the same canvas print (Mary Magdalene at the empty tomb, pink flowers, white-robed risen Christ) on a white background. Print-on-demand mockup.
items.new_site_use: Skip unless there is a canvas or wall-art product. Otherwise it is a secondary gallery image for that product.

items.description: Room-scene mockup: a small canvas of Mary Magdalene at the empty tomb hangs on a white wall above a gray shelf holding stacked pastel books, a black bowl in a wire frame, and a yellow desk lamp.
items.new_site_use: Skip unless canvas wall art is sold. Could be a lifestyle image for that product.

items.description: Room-scene mockup: the small Mary Magdalene empty-tomb canvas hangs on a textured greige wall next to a light switch, with a white twisted vase of bare branches and a stack of magazines on a wood console.
items.new_site_use: Skip unless canvas wall art is sold.

items.description: Print-on-demand mockup of a gray jigsaw puzzle box with the lid shown and loose pieces inside. The lid art shows a smiling bearded man in teal and cream robes holding a scroll or parchment, with olive trees and Jerusalem stone walls behind him, in the Easter Journey illustration style. Box label: '11x14 Puzzle', '252 pcs', 'Ages 9+', plus a barcode.
items.new_site_use: Only if a puzzle product is sold (secondary merch or upsell). Skip for the core funnel.

items.description: Flat, fully assembled puzzle mockup of the same artwork (bearded man holding a scroll among olive trees and Jerusalem walls) on white, with the puzzle cut lines visible.
items.new_site_use: Main puzzle product image if that product exists. Otherwise skip.

items.description: Angled mockup of the same puzzle (bearded man with scroll), nearly complete, with three missing pieces and loose pieces scattered on a white surface.
items.new_site_use: Secondary puzzle gallery image if that product exists. Otherwise skip.

items.description: Composite image of the 'Nephite Christmas' hardcover ('Written by Tiffany Wheeler', 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken') standing in front of a plain closed cardboard shipping box on white. The filename suggests it was used to sell a box of misprinted copies at a discount. The composite looks slightly artificial.
items.new_site_use: Skip for the core funnel. Possible use for a 'bulk / case pack' or seconds/misprint listing if the client still offers one.

items.description: Homepage slider built from the 500A2551 flat-lay photo (book plus coloring book) with white overlay text: 'Draw Closer to Christ this Christmas with our Nephite Christmas Bundle!', 'ON SALE NOW! Both Books for only $25!' and 'Order online with code BUNDLE25'.
items.new_site_use: Skip as outdated: the price and discount code are time-bound. Use the clean 500A2551 photo instead. The copy angle ('Draw Closer to Christ this Christmas') is reusable as headline inspiration. Data point: the book plus coloring book bundle was previously $25.

items.description: 16:9 promo banner. Left: a cropped 500A2551 flat-lay (Nephite Christmas hardcover plus coloring book). Right, on light gray: 'BLACK FRIDAY SALE', '24 HR FLASH SALE', 'BOGO Free!' and 'FRIDAY ONLY' in red and black type.
items.new_site_use: Skip as an outdated Black Friday promo. The same photo is available clean as 500A2551-scaled.jpeg. The layout could be a template for a future seasonal announcement bar.

items.description: Facebook-link-size promo graphic: the Nephite Christmas cartoon boy waving at the left, with watercolor pine, berry and pinecone garland borders at top and bottom. A red stitched circle reads 'Nephite Christmas', '$5 off', 'BLACK FRIDAY SALE', '11/28-12/2' (Black Friday 2025), 'SHOP NOW' and 'Tiffany-Wheeler.com'.
items.new_site_use: Skip as an outdated dated promo (11/28-12/2). The waving-boy character and watercolor pine garland are reusable brand art if the source files exist, and the layout is a template for future seasonal ads.

items.description: Full two-page interior spread from Easter Journey, pages 32-33. On the left an angel figure (white hair, white beard, white robe, arms spread) stands before a silvery olive tree at sunrise. On the right is the empty garden tomb with its round stone rolled aside, and pink tulips in the foreground. The heading 'The Tomb' sits top-right with a paragraph of the angel's words (a scripture-style paraphrase that ends with the proclamation that He is risen). Page numbers 32 and 33 are visible.
items.new_site_use: peek-inside: the strongest real-spread candidate in this batch for the 'Take a Peek Inside' open-book section. Also a good Easter product-gallery slide.

items.description: Square crop of the same pages 32-33 spread. It shows mostly the left page (the angel in a white robe, the olive tree, tulips, page number 32). The right-page text is cut off mid-line at the right edge ('The Tom...', 'Angel: Be n...').
items.new_site_use: Product gallery or social square only if the cut-off text is acceptable. Prefer the full spread (canva18-scaled.jpg) or re-crop it so the text is not truncated.

items.description: Easter Journey front cover, tightly cropped with no padding. Title: script 'Easter' over serif 'JOURNEY'. A smiling older bearded man (the narrator/merchant character: red robe, green tunic, cream scarf) gestures toward the viewer. Behind him, crowds wave palm fronds and Jesus rides a donkey through a Jerusalem street and gate. Credit lines: 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler' / 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'.
items.new_site_use: Product card cover and 3D mockup source. This is the clean edge-to-edge cover. At 656px wide, request the print-resolution cover file from the client for hero use.

items.description: The same Easter Journey cover centered in an 800x800 square with light-gray (#f6f6f6) side padding. The cover art inside is about 650px wide. Same text as the cover: 'Easter Journey', 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler', 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'.
items.new_site_use: Square Shopify product thumbnail or collection grid. The tight crop (Cover-2) or the transparent version is better for custom layouts.

items.description: The same Easter Journey cover in an 800x800 square with transparent side padding (about 18% of the canvas is transparent). Cover.webp and Cover0.webp are byte-identical (same md5).
items.new_site_use: Product cards or hero composites on colored backgrounds where transparent padding helps. Still low-res for a large hero.

items.description: Easter Journey cover on an 800x800 light-gray (#f6f6f6) square with a white corner triangle at bottom-right reading 'PDF Download'. This is the digital/ebook listing image.
items.new_site_use: Product image for an Easter Journey PDF/digital variant, if the new store sells digital. Otherwise skip.

items.description: Transparent-padded version of the Easter Journey 'PDF Download' cover. The side padding is transparent and the bottom-right triangle is semi-transparent white (alpha about 0.8) with the text 'PDF Download'. Download-Cover.webp and Download-Cover0.webp are byte-identical.
items.new_site_use: Digital-variant product image on colored backgrounds. Otherwise skip.

items.description: Wide 16:9 version of the Easter Journey cover art. It is extended with an extra smiling older woman waving a palm frond at the right and more crowd on the left, with Jesus on a donkey in the center background. The 'Easter Journey' title art is at top-center, partly overlapped by the narrator's head. No sale text, no dates, and no Kickstarter wording is visible. The filename suggests it was the Kickstarter campaign image (inference).
items.new_site_use: Evergreen: Easter Journey OG/social share image or mobile hero. Only 1024px wide and fairly compressed, so ask for a higher-res master for a desktop hero.

items.description: Standalone 'Easter Journey' title lettering on a transparent background: white script 'Easter' above cream/ivory serif small-caps 'JOURNEY', with a soft dark drop shadow.
items.new_site_use: Title overlay on an Easter hero or banner, or the Easter section header. It needs a mid or dark background because the lettering is white/cream.

items.description: Wide illustration of a Jerusalem market street at dusk: a cobblestone lane, produce stalls and baskets, candles and lanterns, and an arched gate in the distance. At right, the Easter Journey narrator/merchant (gray hair and beard, red robe, green tunic) smiles, gestures toward the viewer and holds out a red fruit. No text.
items.new_site_use: Easter section background or hero banner. It has open space on the left for headline and CTA. Also usable for About the Book / story-intro.

items.description: Square close crop of the merchant/narrator character in the market street. He smiles with an open hand extended, and a vendor and produce stall are behind him. No text.
items.new_site_use: Character spotlight ('Meet your guide'), Easter product-card secondary image, or social square.

items.description: Wide dusk scene of a stone city gate and tower (Jerusalem) at left. Three robed women walk toward the arched gate on a lit stone path lined with small torches, among olive trees and boulders under an orange-pink sunset. No text. The women heading to the tomb/garden suggests Easter Journey art (inference).
items.new_site_use: Easter hero or section background. The darker right side can hold overlay text. Also good as a full-bleed texture strip.

items.description: Horizontally mirrored copy of feature-image.jpg: the gate and tower are at right and the women walk toward the right-hand gate. No text.
items.new_site_use: The same uses as feature-image, for layouts where the text needs to sit on the left. Pick one of the pair per layout.

items.description: Illustrated landscape: three crosses on a rocky green hilltop (Golgotha) under a stormy teal-to-magenta sky. No text. The filename marks it as a downloadable wallpaper, painted in the Easter Journey style.
items.new_site_use: Free Easter wallpaper lead magnet (email capture), or a subdued background for the Easter section or footer band.

items.description: Resurrected Jesus (smiling, dark hair and beard, white robe) in the foreground left. The open empty tomb and grassy rocks are behind him, with pink tulips at lower right and a sunrise glow at top-left. No text, despite the 'He is Risen' filename.
items.new_site_use: Easter hero or section art, a peek-inside style highlight, or the wallpaper freebie for email capture.

items.description: Jesus (dark hair and beard, gray-green mantle with a red stole) holding a parchment scroll and looking upward. An olive tree and Jerusalem stone walls are behind him under a teal sky. No text.
items.new_site_use: Easter section imagery, story or about-the-book block, or the wallpaper freebie.

items.description: A tearful young woman in a blue head covering (likely Mary Magdalene) at the empty tomb, with the burial slab inside and the rolled stone at left. A white-robed figure is partly visible at right and pink flowers are at lower left. No text.
items.new_site_use: Peek-inside or story highlight for Easter Journey, or the wallpaper freebie.

items.description: Illustration of Jesus gently holding the face of a kneeling bearded man in blue robes (the healing of the blind man), between weathered sandstone columns with city ruins and a blue sky behind. No text. The PNG has an alpha channel but is fully opaque. It appears to be an interior illustration crop (inference).
items.new_site_use: Peek-inside gallery tile or Easter product gallery image showing story content and emotional tone.

items.description: Close portrait of a tearful, hopeful woman with graying dark hair in a tan patterned head covering and a red robe. She stands in a garden with stone arches, a tree and red flowers. No text. The filename says Mary. The PNG has an alpha channel but is fully opaque.
items.new_site_use: Peek-inside tile or Easter product gallery image.

items.description: Cutout of the character James (per the filename): a dark-haired, bearded man in a cream tunic with a blue stole, scratching his head in a puzzled pose. About half the canvas is transparent background. No text.
items.new_site_use: Character callout or decorative accent in the Easter section, e.g. beside an FAQ or the 'who's in the story' block. Works on any background color.

items.description: Painterly white dove in flight with spread wings, a blue-gray tail and pink feet, cut out on a transparent background. No text. It is assigned to Easter Journey because the painting style matches (inference).
items.new_site_use: Decorative accent: hero corner flourish, section divider, or next to the Easter product card. Works on any background.

items.description: Painterly terracotta oil lamp with carved spiral motifs, a handle and a lit flame at the spout, with a soft drop shadow, on a transparent background (about 88% of the canvas is transparent). No text. Assigned to Easter Journey on painting style (inference). It could also suit general scripture-themed decoration.
items.new_site_use: Decorative accent or icon-style illustration, e.g. in the trust row, section headers, or 'light of the world' copy. Trim the transparent padding before use.

items.description: Cover of the companion coloring book, centered on white padding. Text: 'Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure!' and, on a scroll banner, 'Coloring and Activity Book'. The Nephite boy character (red headband, teal tank top) waves in front of palm trees and a Mesoamerican-style stepped stone temple. Front-cover-1.webp is the same image but has a white blotch artifact on the top-right edge, so it should not be used.
items.new_site_use: Coloring book product card or gallery image, add-on or upsell tile, and the bundle bar (Nephite Christmas + coloring book).

items.description: Photo of three printable paper nativity figures standing on paper-ring bases on a white/pale-blue backdrop: kneeling Joseph (blue robe, yellow trim), baby Jesus in a straw manger, and praying Mary (pink robe, purple veil). A purple corner triangle at bottom-right reads 'PDF Download'. Nativity-feature-image-1.webp and -2.webp are byte-identical.
items.new_site_use: Product image for the printable nativity craft (digital add-on, gift-with-purchase, or upsell). Use it in the bundle and upsell area, not the hero.

items.description: Composite of the Nephite Christmas digital bundle on a transparent background: the coloring book cover ('Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure!' / 'Coloring and Acti...', partly hidden), the Nephite Christmas book cover ('Nephite Christmas', 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler', 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken') with a 'PDF Download' corner, and the paper nativity figures (Joseph, manger, Mary) in front. Large black text 'Instant Download' at top-right. The black text disappears on dark backgrounds.
items.new_site_use: Product image for a digital bundle SKU, if one is offered. Useful as a model for a 'What's included' graphic. Use it on a light background only.

items.description: Promo slider. Left half: styled lifestyle photo of the Nephite Christmas hardcover (cover credits Tiffany Wheeler / Kelley Hicken) and the 'Nephite Christmas Adventure!' Coloring and Activity book on white wood planks, with a kraft gift box, pine sprig and gold star ornaments. Right half text: 'ORDER BEFORE DECEMBER 19TH', 'FINAL WEEK', 'BLOWOUT SALE', 'BOGO', '50% off'.
items.new_site_use: Skip for evergreen: dated promo (Dec 19 deadline, BOGO 50%). The left-half book photo is strong, reusable lifestyle art. Crop it, or find the original photo in the library, for a hero, gift section or social proof.

items.description: Store-wide Christmas sale slider. Left: soft flat illustration of the Holy Family (Joseph in a teal robe, Mary in a white veil, swaddled baby Jesus) under a bright star on a night sky. Right, on navy: '20% OFF EVERYTHING!', 'FREE ACTIVITY BOOK WITH $50 Purchase', 'FREE NATIVITY CRAFT DOWNLOAD with $75 purchase', and an orange 'SHOP NOW' button.
items.new_site_use: Skip for evergreen: Dec 9 sale banner. The Holy Family art on the left is reusable for a Christmas section if the client has it without text. The tiered free-gift offer (free activity book at $50, free nativity craft at $75) is a useful precedent for an AOV threshold offer.

items.description: Shipping-deadline slider. Left: stock photo of a smiling delivery man in a navy cap and polo holding a cardboard box in front of a van. Right, on tan: 'HURRY!', 'FINAL DAY TO ORDER AND RECIEVE IT BEFORE CHRISTMAS*' (note the 'RECIEVE' typo), 'DECEMBER 19TH', '*FOR MOST STATES -NOT GUARANTEED'.
items.new_site_use: Skip: dated, generic stock photo, and it contains a typo. The concept is worth reusing seasonally as a shipping-cutoff announcement bar or countdown (text only).

items.description: Ad or social graphic (1200x628 link-ad size). On a cream background, the Nephite boy character (red headband, teal top) waves at left, with olive branches and berry dots. A sage-green dashed circle holds the text: 'Nephite Christmas' logo, 'GENERAL CONFERENCE 20% OFF SALE', 'Order this weekend and save!', 'CODE: GENCONF', a 'SHOP NOW' button and 'Tiffany-Wheeler.com'.
items.new_site_use: Skip for evergreen (time-bound discount code). The waving boy artwork and palette (cream, sage, deep red) are a useful brand reference. General Conference weekend (April/October) is a recurring promo window for this LDS audience.

items.description: Halloween sale banner, the full version. Black silhouette haunted house, bare trees and crosses in front of a full moon on orange. The Nephite Christmas hardcover and coloring book are composited at lower left. Text: 'HALLOWEEN SALE' (with jack-o-lanterns), 'FREE Coloring Book with each Book Purchased!', 'Grab this "SCARY GOOD" deal before it's too late!', an 'ORDER NOW' button, and '*Offer ends on Halloween!'.
items.new_site_use: Skip: seasonal Halloween promo. The 'free coloring book with each book' offer is a useful bundle/GWP precedent.

items.description: Halloween sale banner variant with the same art as IMG_6712 but a slightly taller canvas. Text: 'HALLOWEEN SALE', 'FREE Coloring Book with each Book Purchased!', and 'Grab this "SCARY GOOD" deal before it's too late!'. No button and no end-date line.
items.new_site_use: Skip: seasonal Halloween promo.

items.description: The simplest Halloween sale banner variant, with the same art. Text: 'HALLOWEEN SALE' and 'FREE Coloring Book with each Book Purchased!' only.
items.new_site_use: Skip: seasonal Halloween promo.

items.description: Photo of a DIY Easter 'resurrection garden': a terracotta pot of fresh grass with three twig crosses, a small clay-pot 'tomb' with a round stone rolled in front, and pebbles, on a lace tablecloth. Overlaid text: 'RESURRECTION GARDEN' / 'GRASS SEEDS'. A small line-art logo (kitchen utensils or jars) in the bottom-right corner looks like a third-party blog watermark, so it may not be the client's own photo.
items.new_site_use: Skip unless the client confirms she sells a resurrection-garden seed add-on and owns this photo. If so, use it as an Easter add-on product image. Verify rights because of the watermark.

items.description: Natural-color outdoor headshot of a smiling woman with shoulder-length auburn/brown hair in a purple button-up top, with a blurred wooded background. She is the illustrator Kelley Hicken: the covers credit 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken', and the filename misspells it 'Heckin'.
items.new_site_use: About page 'Meet the Illustrator' block (small, since the file is only 600px wide). Not the author, so don't use it as Tiffany's photo.

items.description: A second, near-square headshot of illustrator Kelley Hicken, apparently from the same photo shoot as Kelley-Heckin.jpg. It is heavily filtered: over-sharpened, grainy and high-contrast, with darker hair tones and a warm, faded wooded background.
items.new_site_use: Backup only. Prefer Kelley-Heckin.jpg for the illustrator bio. The heavy filter looks dated and low quality.

items.description: 3D mockup of both hardcover books standing side by side on a plain warm-cream background with soft shadows. Left is Nephite Christmas: purple night cover with the Mesoamerican stone arch, a boy in a red headband and teal tunic holding a torch, 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler / Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'. Right is 'Easter JOURNEY' (script 'Easter' over serif 'JOURNEY'): a painterly Jerusalem street scene with a smiling grey-bearded man in a brown robe, a woman and a man waving palm fronds, and Jesus on a donkey in the background, 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler / Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'. Observed: the Easter Journey cover is painted in a more realistic style than the flat cartoon style of Nephite Christmas. Inference: the mockup may be AI-generated or composited, and the Easter cover may not be final, so confirm with the client. PNG and WEBP match (pixel diff about 0.2).

batch_notes:
All 62 files were viewed (through previews) and sorted into 32 groups. Duplicates were confirmed by RMSE comparison as well as viewing. coloring-book-cover-thumbnail.webp and coloring-book-cover-thumbnail0.webp are pixel-identical.

KEY FACTS OBSERVED:
(1) The Christmas book's printed title is 'Nephite Christmas', with no 'A'.
(2) The Easter cover reads 'Easter Journey'. No 'Promised Messiah' subtitle appears on these assets.
(3) Both books credit 'Written by Tiffany Wheeler' and 'Illustrated by Kelley Hicken'.
(4) The Nephite Christmas line includes a hardcover, a companion 'Join me for a Nephite Christmas Adventure! Coloring and Activity Book' (sold as print and as a 'PDF Download'), and a white ceramic 'Nephite Christmas' star ornament.
